title: 第一卷 第17章 罗家易主第一卷 第18章 亲生的
lines: 下方的罗府众人，一个个面如死灰。
现在，是不是轮到他们了？
秦绝身形一闪，飘落到罗府之中。
所有罗府的人，都骇得往后退了退。
秦绝淡漠的目光，扫了一眼罗府众人，冰冷道：“罗望之错，我也不想牵连太多人，而且你们还算老实，所以我不会杀了你们。这罗家麾下，有不少产业，我无暇打理，你们之中，谁愿接手？愿意接手的人，以后每个月，只需给我上供五成利润即可！当然，这个人，不能是罗家人！”
人群中的罗家供奉和护卫们，一个个眼神大亮！
这岂不是说，他们不仅可以不用死，还能得到天大的好处？
哪怕是上供五成利润，那剩下的五成利润，也是他们以前想都不敢想的泼天富贵啊！
“秦少爷，属下刘长山，愿意接手！”一个壮硕的中年男子，踏步上前，躬身抱拳道。
秦绝打量了一眼刘长山，此人气血充盈，内气雄浑，是个宗师境七重强者，在这一群人里，的确是修为最强的人了。
“刘长山，你这个浑蛋，你竟敢觊觎我罗家产业！”一个罗家子弟，惊怒道。
刘长山眼中眯起一道凶气，看向秦绝道：“秦少爷，这个人，属下可以杀了吗？”
秦绝眉头微挑，这刘长山，还真是个狠辣角色。
“以后罗家的产业罗家的人，都归你来管。你觉得谁该死，杀了就是。”秦绝淡笑道。
“多谢少爷！”刘长山惊喜一声，单膝跪行一礼。
那罗家子弟则是惊恐至极，口中叫道：“秦绝，你刚才说过了，不会杀我们的，你……你不能说话不算数啊！”
秦绝笑道：“我说话向来作数，可现在要杀你的，并不是我。”
刘长山直起腰身，脚步一转，迅猛冲到罗家青年跟前，右手一剑，噗嗤一声，干脆利落的贯穿了对方心脏！
“罗家今日易主，再有忤逆者，死！”
刘长山喝吼一声，拔剑而出，一股血水，喷到丈外。
嘭嘭嘭——
满院子里的人，吓得齐齐跪下，没人再敢吭声半句。
秦绝淡笑道：“刘长山，你很不错。日后有什么解决不了的麻烦，就去秦家找我。”
刘长山激动道：“是，少爷！”
“找到罗开岳和王霄的储物戒，送去秦家。”
吩咐之后，秦绝离开了罗家。
罗府不远处的大街上，韩文昭带着韩家人，早已和王家、罗家的人拼杀到了一起。
有韩文昭这个大宗师境在，王家、罗家的一众强者，即便再挣扎，也翻不出多大的浪花来。
此刻，地上已经躺下近七、八十具尸体。
只剩下罗望、王圣二人，背靠着背，被韩家众人围在中央。
“韩文昭，韩风，你们这两个背信弃义的无耻之徒，老子就算做了鬼，也不会放过你们的！”罗望一头蓬发，脸上、身上全是血，眼珠子瞪得赤红。
韩文昭淡漠道：“罗望，你有什么资格在这里跟老夫叫吼？若非是你撺掇，我三大家族，岂有今夜之祸？要说委屈，王家才是真的有点委屈。老夫听说，原本王家是打算交出地契的，是因为你的撺掇，王家才改了主意。”
“对对！就是这样的！要不是罗望这厮怂恿，我王家岂会犯蠢！韩老爷子，还请你帮我跟秦少爷求个情，让他饶过我王家这一回如何？我王家，愿意臣服秦少爷，自此成为秦家的附属家族！”王圣赶忙道。
此刻的王圣，早已精疲力尽，一身是伤。
content_en:
The people in the Luo Mansion below all looked ashen.
Now, is it their turn?
Qin Jue's figure flashed and fell into the Luo Mansion.
All the people in Luo Mansion were so horrified that they stepped back.
Qin Jue glanced at everyone in Luo Mansion with an indifferent gaze, and said coldly: "It's Luo Wang's fault, I don't want to implicate too many people, and you are quite honest, so I won't kill you. There are many properties under the Luo family, and I have no time to take care of them. Who among you is willing to take over? Those who are willing to take over, only need to give me 50% of the profit every month from now on! Of course, this person cannot be the Luo family!"
The eyes of the Luo family worshipers and guards in the crowd were all bright!
Doesn't this mean that not only do they not have to die, but they can also get great benefits?
Even if they offer 50% of the profit, the remaining 50% of the profit will be a wealth that they never dared to imagine before!
"Master Qin, my subordinate Liu Changshan is willing to take over!" A sturdy middle-aged man stepped forward, bowed and clasped his fists.
Qin Jue took a look at Liu Changshan. He was full of Qi and blood, and had a strong internal Qi. He was a seventh-level master-level expert. Among this group of people, he was indeed the strongest person in cultivation.
"Liu Changshan, you bastard, how dare you covet my Luo family's property!" A member of the Luo family said in shock and anger.
Liu Changshan narrowed his eyes with a fierce look and looked at Qin Jue: "Master Qin, can my subordinates kill this person?"
Qin Jue raised his eyebrows slightly, Liu Changshan was really a ruthless character.
"From now on, you will be in charge of the Luo family's property and the Luo family's people. Just kill whoever you think deserves to die." Qin Jue said with a faint smile.
"Thank you, Master!" Liu Changshan exclaimed in surprise and knelt down on one knee to salute.
The children of the Luo family were extremely frightened and shouted: "Qin Jue, you just said you wouldn't kill us, you... you can't keep your word!"
Qin Jue smiled and said, "I always mean what I say, but now I'm not the one who wants to kill you."
Liu Changshan straightened up, turned his steps, and rushed to the young man of the Luo family. With a sword in his right hand, he pierced the opponent's heart with a pop!
"The Luo family has changed owners today. If anyone disobeys again, he will die!"
Liu Changshan roared, drew his sword, and a stream of blood sprayed out ten feet away.
Bang bang bang——
All the people in the courtyard knelt down in fear, and no one dared to say a word.
Qin Jue smiled lightly and said: "Liu Changshan, you are very good. If you have any trouble that cannot be solved in the future, just go to the Qin family to find me."
Liu Changshan said excitedly: "Yes, young master!"
"Find Luo Kaiyue and Wang Xiao's storage rings and send them to the Qin family."
"Yes!"
After giving the instructions, Qin Jue left the Luo family.
On the street not far from Luo Mansion, Han Wenzhao and his family were already fighting with the Wang family and Luo family.
With Han Wenzhao as a great master, the powerful men of the Wang family and the Luo family could not make much trouble no matter how hard they struggled.
At this moment, nearly seventy to eighty corpses were lying on the ground.
Only Luo Wang and Wang Sheng were left, back to back, surrounded by everyone in the Han family.
"Han Wenzhao, Han Feng, you two treacherous and shameless people, even if I become a ghost, I will not let you go!" Luo Wang had unkempt hair, his face and body were covered with blood, and his eyes were red.
Han Wenzhao said indifferently: "Luo Wang, what qualifications do you have to yell at me here? If it weren't for your instigation, how would our three major families be in trouble tonight? Speaking of grievances, the Wang family is really a little aggrieved. I heard that originally the Wang family planned to hand over the land deed, but it was because of your instigation that the Wang family changed their mind."
"That's right! That's it! If it weren't for Luo Wang's instigation, how could my Wang family be stupid! Mr. Han, please help me beg Master Qin to let him spare my Wang family this time? My Wang family is willing to surrender to Master Qin and become a subsidiary family of the Qin family from now on!" Wang Sheng said hurriedly.
At this moment, Wang Sheng was exhausted and covered in wounds.
